name: authorize-app-card
title: Authorize app card
description: The OAuth consent screen: which app wants access, as whom, to what, in plain-language scopes, with Allow and Deny as two filled buttons of one size.
docs: app is { name, publisher?, verified?, icon?, logo? }: verified is said in words with an icon (Verified, Unverified), and an unverified app also gets a warning, written in the card's own greys with a warning icon (no colour needed). account is { email, name?, avatar? }, with onSwitchAccount for Not you?. scopes are { id, label, description, access: 'read' or 'write', required? }, listed in a Read group and a Write group: a required scope shows a lock and the word Required instead of a checkbox, a write scope carries the word Write as well as its icon, and the whole row is a click target for its checkbox. defaultGranted lists the optional scopes that start ticked (default all of them). onAllow(grantedScopeIds) receives the required ids and the ticked ones; onDeny is a filled button of the same size as Allow and the first of the two in the tab order, never a text link. Both buttons wait while either works, the one pressed shows a spinner and then Allowed or Denied, and a rejection shows a message and loses nothing. redirectHost is named in the footer line, with the reminder that access can be removed in settings. footer, titleAs (the permissions heading sits one level under it) and labels as in the other cards.
